certificate_inputs.proposal_type: OverlapCertificate { context, ordered_root_groups, cell_modes, root_reads, old_history_projection, event_delta, new_target, cut_delta, error_bounds, work_receipt }

proof_obligations.required: Every finite exact root lies inside original discovery and [0,stop]. All relevant source knots/predicate roots are enumerated. Reject missing provenance or partial coverage.

Compare exact roots using bounded rational arithmetic. Form one group only for exact equality. Preserve strictly ordered unequal roots even when they share a binary64 enclosure/representative. Verify accepted cursor order.

For every real open cell between ordered roots, prove source segment, source predicate signs and selected target under the correct held epoch. A binary64 interior sample suffices only with complete affine cut coverage. Without one, use a bounded rational witness plus exact sign/cut-completeness proof, or reject; never use an endpoint as interior.

At every exact root evaluate strict/nonstrict predicates and selected target separately from left/right limits. Reject a point target different from both permitted adjacent targets. After settlement compare against OLD accepted target as well, not only a frozen pre-event plan.

Event statements read original physical input at incoming exact root, respecting program assignment order and existing same-time writer rules. Source phase is determined by exact root order. Enclose arithmetic and propagate uncertainty; a representative sample is never a replacement.

Consume each source cut exactly once by (source identity, exact root/group, epoch). A no-op target corner advances source phase/cursor without restarting a transition. Equal source/user roots have one settlement group and one commit, not two sequential events chosen by insertion order.

Project old accepted transition/history through the ordered roots before constructing changed target history. Preserve ongoing ramps, delayed queues, uncertainty, unrelated histories and call-site ownership. If an existing timed consumer cannot retain exact root/window semantics, reject. Do not force event root to source cut or mutate accepted start times.

Evaluate original residual, event root-time error, physical sample error and propagated output/history voltage error at existing acceptance gates. Success in root ordering cannot bypass downstream rejection.

Prepare entirely on candidate snapshot. Commit held states, all histories, calendar, source cut consumption and exact cursor atomically after all checks. On failure restore all accepted physical state; proof work stays charged and rejected reservations are not refunded.
Output queries are pure observations of accepted history. Additional coarse/dense boundary queries cannot consume a source cut, change roots or rebuild a different physical schedule.
